prompts.label: A｜コンパクトな一列ミキサー
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a polished, shippable high-fidelity iPhone app screenshot, portrait aspect ratio matching the supplied screenshot. Image 1 is the edit target and visual reference. Redesign ONLY the bottom audio settings sheet of this Japanese lofi focus app. Keep the upper app context (black background, underlined Japanese scene title, small audio settings icon, vertical numbered rank circles, blue neon pixel-art rooftop city with a small girl at her desk) recognizably unchanged, softly dimmed behind the modal. Do not redesign or reillustrate the rooftop artwork. No phone hardware frame, no perspective, no hands, no presentation board, no external labels. Show ONE complete screen, not a collage. The sheet occupies roughly the lower half to 55 percent of the screen and must show ALL FIVE channels without scrolling or cut-off controls. Modal header exact text "この場所の音", a subtle drag handle and a small close icon. Exact channel labels "BGM", "作業音", "葉擦れ", "雨", "暖炉"; BGM track title "Night Signal". These are existing placeholder channel names, preserve them. Elegant Japanese typography, precise alignment, convincing iOS touch target sizes. Palette: near-black sheet #101012, soft off-white text, muted gray secondary type, restrained warm champagne accents. Black-centered, quiet, atmospheric, sophisticated. No bright neon UI, no rainbow, no thick dividers, no large default iOS toggle switches, no extra product features, no promotional copy, no giant English headings. Active BGM, leaves and rain; keyboard and fire muted. Distinct clear active/inactive states. Exact text only, clean readable typography. Concept A: editorial compact inline mixing list. A restrained dedicated BGM row near the top includes a tiny music-note icon, "BGM" and "Night Signal" on two lines, plus a small play/pause circular button. Beneath it, each environmental sound is a very clean SINGLE LINE: a thin simple sound icon on the left, short Japanese label, a slim horizontal volume track with a SMALL 8px circular thumb, and a tiny muted percentage aligned at the far right. Make all five channels including BGM have visible volume adjustment. Muting is done by tapping the small icon; no separate switches. No per-row cards. Generous but compact row spacing, hairline tracks, very few separators. This design should feel like a refined minimalist audio settings panel, not a generic system settings form. Keep the bottom home indicator visible.
